problem: Find a vector equation of the straight line passing through $P(-2,1,8)$ and parallel to $v=⟨8,0,-5⟩.$
worked_solution:
The vector equation of the straight line passing through $P$ and parallel to $v$ is given by

$$
r=p+tv,
$$

where $t\in (-\infty ,\infty )$ and $p$ is the position vector of $P.$

In our case, the position vector of the point $P$ is $p=⟨-2,1,8⟩.$

Using the formula for the vector equation of a line, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}r=⟨-2,1,8⟩+t⟨8,0,-5⟩,\,t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$
